meta.description:
Tracks downloads the OpenClaw media agent starts and reports back to the WhatsApp group when they finish, break, or run long. No LLM is used: the agent's turn ends at the grab, and everything below is plumbing.

Three entry points:
  POST /webhook/track-download   from the OpenClaw media agent (an MCP REST tool) right after a grab
  POST /webhook/arr-event        from Sonarr/Radarr Connect (onDownload, onUpgrade, onManualInteractionRequired)
  every 20 min                   sweeps pending records and gives up on stale ones
  daily at 18:00                 digest of imports nobody asked for (RSS grabs,
                                 monitored sequels, upgrades), only if any landed

State lives in redis under the n8n:openclaw:dl: namespace, keyed by <app>:<episode-or-movie id>, TTL 48h so nothing leaks.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { tracked: true, key: $('build record').first().json.key } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ name: 'message', args: Object.assign({ action: 'send', channel: $json.channel, to: $json.to, message: $json.message }, $json.media ? { media: $json.media } : {}) }) }}
